environments.name: Desk
environments.notes: Indoor, room temperature; a hand pressing down (~2 kg).

environments.name: Outdoor
environments.notes: Sun-heated surface up to ~45 C. UV ageing is not simulated.

environments.name: Bike mount
environments.notes: Static equivalent of a ~2 g bump on a ~2.5 kg load. Vibration and fatigue are not simulated.

environments.name: Car dashboard 80°C
environments.notes: A parked car in summer reaches ~80 C; PLA and PETG soften well below that.

face_ids: or a face id ("f3") from mirror_measure face_list / mirror_faces
